description: u-maker hooks. PreToolUse: on-edit-guard.js is the side-effect gatekeeper (OFF by default; opt-in via U_MAKER_EDIT_GATE=on/auto/strict) — it asks for explicit user approval (a prompt led by an emphasized '⚠️ SIDE-EFFECT IMPACT — 사이드이펙트 영향도 있음' banner) only before a BEHAVIOR-MODIFYING fix to ALREADY-IMPLEMENTED, DEPENDED-UPON code (git-tracked + clean = committed/shipped AND imported/referenced by another source file AND the edit changes/removes existing lines rather than purely adding) in a u-maker project (Edit/Write/MultiEdit/Bash), so a fix to shared code cannot introduce silent regressions in its dependents (the prompt names them). New files, in-progress (untracked/dirty) files, LEAF files that nothing imports, and PURELY-ADDITIVE edits (new content keeps every existing line verbatim) are NOT gated, so forward construction and self-contained or additive changes stay friction-free. (Caveats: the dependent check is an import-graph scan — API routes / DB schema / env contracts are not detected; the additive check is structural — an insertion that still alters behavior reads as additive — both remain the agent's Step 0.5 responsibility.) Mode via U_MAKER_EDIT_GATE=off (DEFAULT — gate disabled) | on=auto (the low-noise policy above) | strict (every add+modify to every existing file); the gate stays OFF unless explicitly set to on/auto/strict. Wired directly, NOT through _dispatch.js (which never blocks). PostToolUse: reactive hooks keep dropzone index, doc<->JSON sync, gate loop state, and deploy staleness in sync after file mutations, dispatched through _dispatch.js.
